current_evidence: The 'Validation Requirements - Planning' page itself shows 'Published 04/05/2023' and 'Last Updated 15/09/2025', and a search found no newer Devon CC list (only an older '/document/validation-requirements' page without the -2 suffix).

issues.detail: The workbook leaves the List date and Date basis empty and flags the list 'Undated'. The page shows its own publication and update dates.

Every requirement is put under 'Full planning' with the note 'INFERRED... placed under Full planning'. Meanwhile 'Minerals & waste (county)' and 'County own devt (Reg 3)' show '(none)', yet those are exactly the application types this list governs. The page says the requirements apply to waste and Regulation 3 development across full, outline, reserved matters, change of use, extension of time, variation of condition and retrospective applications. So the '(none)' entries for Reserved matters and Variation of condition s73 are also wrong. Householder, LBC, advert and similar types are district matters and should be marked not applicable rather than 'national requirements only'.
issues.evidence: 'These validation requirements apply to waste and Regulation 3 development' ... 'all types of applications, including: full, outline, reserved matters, change of use, extension of time, variation of condition and retrospective applications'

issues.detail: Mineral applications use a separate validation route that Grokbot did not capture. Its own tab_item mentions this, yet Minerals & waste (county) shows '(none)'.
issues.evidence: 'Mineral applications ... should be submitted using the separate DCC M1 form'

issues.detail: Flood Risk Assessment is filed only under 'Outline' and 'Change of use - prior approval' because the trigger text mentions 'change of use'. It applies to any waste or Reg 3 application in FZ2/3, over 1ha in FZ1, in a Critical Drainage Area, or under 1ha in FZ1 with other flood sources. Prior approvals are not covered by this list.
issues.evidence: 3.9 The water environment - Flood Risk Assessment: 'Flood Zones 2 and 3; over 1 ha in Flood Zone 1; Critical Drainage Areas in Flood Zone 1; or under 1 ha in Flood Zone 1 with other flood sources'

issues.detail: Grokbot captured only about 15 items, and many requirements on the page are missing: Design and Access Statement (CA/WHS with 1+ dwellings or over 100m², and major; exempt for waste, engineering/mining, change of use); Utilities Site Survey (utilities within or next to the site); Planning Statement (all applications); Waste Planning Statement (all waste applications); Education Statement (school developments increasing pupil numbers); Community Consultation Statement (all applications, especially where the boundary is shared with residential or sensitive uses); Environmental Statement (Sch 1, or Sch 2 with likely significant effects); Green Infrastructure Scheme (all major); Landscape and Ecological Management Plan (major schemes needing long-term mitigation); Heritage Statement (WHS, listed building, conservation area, archaeology, non-designated assets and their settings); Habitats Regulations Assessment information (may affect SAC/SPA/Ramsar, including South Hams SAC / Beer Quarry and Caves SAC); Biodiversity Metric and 10% net gain (all applications unless agreed); Wildlife and Geology Information (all applications); AONB Statement (within or affecting the setting of an AONB); Landscaping Scheme; Open Space and Public Rights of Way Statement; Road Safety Audit (any change to the existing highway); Sustainable Drainage Scheme (major, or minor altering drainage); Hydrological and Hydrogeological Assessments (waste with significant groundworks, dewatering, abstraction or infilling; major Reg 3); Foul Drainage Assessment (non-mains foul drainage); Coastal Change (vulnerable coastal areas/CCMAs); Sustainable Design Statement (all applications); Waste Audit Statement (major, or significant waste volumes); Construction Management Scheme; Pollution Control Statement (all major); Agricultural Land Classification and Soil Statement (BMV Grades 1, 2, 3a, or new/extended waste disposal); Phase 2 contamination report.

Several rows carry another requirement's text. 'Contaminated Land' carries the Geo-technical Data (Land Stability Report) trigger; the actual trigger is 'contamination could be an issue due to the previous use of the site or adjacent land, or a sensitive use'. 'Ecological Survey / Assessment' carries the external lighting text. 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' carries the Sustainable Design Statement carbon-emissions text; the waste items are the Waste Planning Statement and Waste Audit Statement. 'Pre-application advice' is a line from the Planning Statement content list. 'Coal Mining / Land Stability' is the land stability report; Devon has no coal mining requirement.
issues.evidence: 3.13 Contaminated Land Assessment (Phase 1 Study): 'Required where contamination could be an issue due to the previous use of the site or adjacent land, or where the application is for a sensitive use'; 3.10 'Sustainable Design Statement: All applications'; 'Waste Audit Statement: major development or significant volumes of waste'

issues.detail: Other triggers are fragments or quote a side note instead of the 'When is it required' text. Transport Assessment reads only 'to the Transport Assessment/Transport Statement if required (see below).'; the actual trigger is all developments generating significant movement. Travel Plan is a cross-reference sentence; the actual trigger is school developments increasing pupil numbers, significant sustainable/active travel movement, or any increase in motorised transport. LVIA quotes the cumulative CLVIA sentence instead of 'likely to have significant landscape and/or visual effects'. 'Open space / play space' is really the Playing Field Assessment, cut off mid-sentence. Most excerpts are cut off mid-word at a fixed length.
issues.evidence: 3.8: 'Transport Statement or Assessment: All developments generating significant movement'; 3.6: 'LVIA: Applications likely to have significant landscape and/or visual effects'

issues.detail: Several tab_items are navigation, process or reference text rather than requirements: 'Validation requirements for planning applications PDF version Biodiversity Net Gain Validation Guidance PDF Version Applicants for mineral developments should use ... form M1' (link text); the paper-copy submission instructions ('send it to the address below ... three copies'); the electronic file rules ('no individual document should be greater than 5MB ... Invalid applications'); the hard-copy LVIA visualisation request; and a list of guidance references filed as 'Policy-driven requirements (all application types)' ('Biodiversity and Geological Conservation ... (2005) Policy W11 ... MAGIC Maps ... Natural England Standing Advice').
issues.evidence: tab_items 'Submission rules' rows 1-4 and 'Policy-driven requirements' row 1

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Devon CC validation page (updated 15/09/2025), but it recorded the list as undated. It filed everything under 'Full planning' although the list governs waste and Reg 3 development (both marked '(none)'), missed most of the ~45 requirements, and has several triggers taken from the wrong requirement.
